tftp_bind_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) the TFTP server should listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

tftp_port.description: UDP port number for the TFTP server. Standard TFTP uses port 69.

tftp_root.description: Absolute filesystem path to the TFTP root directory. Must be readable and contain boot files (e.g., pxelinux.0, initrd, vmlinuz).

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 support for TFTP. Not all clients support IPv6 TFTP — disable if issues occur.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent TFTP sessions. Adjust based on server capacity.

secure_mode.description: Enforce strict security: chroot, disable directory listing, and require minimal file permissions. Recommended for production.

items.description: CIDR-restricted IPv4 or IPv6 subnets allowed to access the TFTP server. Empty list allows all.

allowed_subnets.description: List of allowed client subnets in CIDR notation. Restrict for security.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Use 'debug' only for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to log file, or '-' to log to standard output (e.g., for systemd journal).

default_bootfile.description: Name of the default boot file (e.g., pxelinux.0, grubx64.efi) served to clients that don't request a specific one.

bootfile_prefix.description: Optional path prefix prepended to bootfile names (e.g., '/pxe/' → /pxe/pxelinux.0).

dhcp_assist_enabled.description: Enable DHCP request relay to an external DHCP server (e.g., for IPAM, DNS, or advanced lease control).

dhcp_assist_server.description: IP address of the external DHCP server to relay requests to (only if dhcp_assist_enabled=true).

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS fallback for downloading large files (e.g., ISOs) when TFTP is insufficient. Requires a web server.

https_server.description: Base URL of the HTTPS web server for fallback downloads (e.g., https://mirror/).

https_base_path.description: Path prefix on the HTTPS server where boot assets are served (e.g., /debian-edu/router/iso/).

https_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate chain file (PEM format) for the HTTPS fallback server.

pxe_proxy.description: Enable PXE proxy mode (e.g., when using dnsmasq to handle both DHCP and TFTP in one service).

post_boot_script.description: Optional command/script to run after a successful boot (e.g., /usr/local/bin/log-boot.sh). Empty disables it.

transfer_timeout.description: TFTP transfer timeout in seconds. 0 = no timeout. Non-zero may cause failures on high-latency links.

tftp_blocksize.description: Block size (in bytes) for TFTP transfers. 1408 is optimal for standard Ethernet (avoids fragmentation).
